purpose: mobile signups dashboard vs backend by week
sql:
WITH dash AS (
  SELECT device,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups
  FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
  GROUP BY device
),
backend AS (
  SELECT device,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups
  FROM app_pg.accounts
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
  GROUP BY device
)
SELECT COALESCE(d.device, b.device) AS device,
       d.prior_signups AS dashboard_prior,
       d.last_signups AS dashboard_last,
       b.prior_signups AS backend_prior,
       b.last_signups AS backend_last,
       ROUND(100.0 * (d.last_signups - d.prior_signups) / NULLIF(d.prior_signups, 0), 3) AS dashboard_pct_change,
       ROUND(100.0 * (b.last_signups - b.prior_signups) / NULLIF(b.prior_signups, 0), 3) AS backend_pct_change,
       (d.last_signups - b.last_signups) AS last_week_gap,
       (d.prior_signups - b.prior_signups) AS prior_week_gap
FROM dash d
FULL OUTER JOIN backend b ON d.device = b.device

purpose: mobile signups by channel from dashboard for both weeks
sql:
SELECT channel,
       SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
       SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) AS pct_change
FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
WHERE device = 'mobile'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY prior_signups DESC

purpose: mobile dashboard vs backend by channel group, prior vs last week, to size measurement gap vs real decline
sql:
WITH dash AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN channel IN ('paid_search','paid_social','display') THEN 'paid' ELSE 'non_paid' END AS channel_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS dash_prior,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS dash_last
  FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
  GROUP BY 1
),
backend AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN signup_channel IN ('paid_search','paid_social','display') THEN 'paid' ELSE 'non_paid' END AS channel_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS backend_prior,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS backend_last
  FROM app_pg.accounts
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(d.channel_group, b.channel_group) AS channel_group,
  d.dash_prior, d.dash_last, (d.dash_last - d.dash_prior) AS dash_change,
  b.backend_prior, b.backend_last, (b.backend_last - b.backend_prior) AS backend_change,
  (d.dash_prior - b.backend_prior) AS gap_prior, (d.dash_last - b.backend_last) AS gap_last
FROM dash d FULL JOIN backend b ON d.channel_group = b.channel_group
ORDER BY 1

purpose: mobile sessions prior vs last week by paid vs non-paid channel
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN channel IN ('paid_search','paid_social','display') THEN 'paid' ELSE 'non_paid' END AS channel_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN session_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS prior_sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN session_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS last_sessions
  FROM app_pg.sessions_daily
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  channel_group,
  prior_sessions,
  last_sessions,
  last_sessions - prior_sessions AS change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (last_sessions - prior_sessions) / NULLIF(prior_sessions, 0), 3) AS pct_change
FROM s
ORDER BY channel_group

purpose: backend mobile accounts prior vs last week by paid vs non-paid signup channel
sql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN signup_channel IN ('paid_search','paid_social','display') THEN 'paid' ELSE 'non_paid' END AS channel_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior_accounts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_accounts
  FROM app_pg.accounts
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  channel_group,
  prior_accounts,
  last_accounts,
  last_accounts - prior_accounts AS change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (last_accounts - prior_accounts) / NULLIF(prior_accounts, 0), 3) AS pct_change
FROM a
ORDER BY channel_group

purpose: daily mobile dashboard vs backend signups Oct 5-18 with Thanksgiving flag
sql:
WITH mobile_signups AS (
  SELECT signup_date AS dt,
         SUM(signups) AS dashboard_signups
  FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
    AND signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
  GROUP BY signup_date
),
mobile_accounts AS (
  SELECT to_date(created_at) AS dt,
         COUNT(*) AS backend_accounts
  FROM app_pg.accounts
  WHERE device = 'mobile'
    AND to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
  GROUP BY to_date(created_at)
),
holiday_check AS (
  SELECT holiday_date AS dt, holiday_name
  FROM whybot.ca_holidays
  WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(s.dt, a.dt, h.dt) AS dt,
  s.dashboard_signups,
  a.backend_accounts,
  h.holiday_name,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s.dt, a.dt, h.dt) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 'prior'
    WHEN COALESCE(s.dt, a.dt, h.dt) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 'last'
  END AS week_bucket
FROM mobile_signups s
FULL OUTER JOIN mobile_accounts a ON s.dt = a.dt
FULL OUTER JOIN holiday_check h ON COALESCE(s.dt, a.dt) = h.dt
ORDER BY dt

purpose: non-budget ad changes on paid mobile-relevant campaigns Oct 12-18
sql:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.channel, c.platform,
       l.change_type, l.old_value, l.new_value,
       to_date(l.changed_at) AS changed_date, l.changed_by
FROM ads_pg.ad_change_log l
JOIN ads_pg.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = l.campaign_id
WHERE l.change_type <> 'daily_budget'
  AND to_date(l.changed_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
  AND c.channel IN ('paid_search','paid_social','display')
ORDER BY changed_date, c.campaign_id

purpose: mobile dashboard signups by week split paid vs non-paid to size real demand share of -251
sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 'prior'
       WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 'last' END AS week,
  CASE WHEN channel IN ('paid_search','paid_social','display') THEN 'paid' ELSE 'non_paid' END AS channel_group,
  SUM(signups) AS signups
FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
WHERE device = 'mobile'
  AND signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
